ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.08:0.92; the surface is predominantly composed of low-intensity dark pixels with sparse high-intensity white/yellow pixels localized at the distal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast yellowish-white clusters (blobs) are concentrated at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes; isolated high-intensity focal points are visible along the trailing edge and near the median notch base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; internal angle of approximately 50 degrees; depth is significant relative to the horizontal width of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrations along the entire trailing boundary; peak-to-valley amplitude is most pronounced at the lateral fluke terminations where deep, jagged notches occur.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: A continuous concave curvature extending from the central median notch vertex outward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast pixels (circular in geometry) are visible at the extreme lateral ends of both lobes, corresponding to barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical-oriented dark linear disruptions are detected across the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy irregular scarring and encrustations at the fluke tips; a singular bright white vertical streak is visible at the junction of the fluke and the peduncle.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high concentration of dark pigmentation across >90% of the visible ventral area.
